text:
morgan: Follow-up from the postmortem: we need a crisp decision on customer-facing comms for this incident and the recurring cache-pressure pattern. Items: status page line, 72h redacted technical brief, RCA sharing matrix (public vs enterprise), and CSM outreach template. Proposed owners: @kim status page + email snippet, @diego 72h brief, @abby RCA policy + CSM template. Pls ack and give ETA.

kim: Ack. I can own status page + short email. Draft status line below; its intentionally minimal. Feedback welcome.

kim: ```
Service impact: Increased latency and intermittent errors for a subset of requests.
Status: Resolved at 08:55 UTC.
Cause: Prefix KV cache pressure (under investigation).
Note: We are tracking this as part of a recurring cache-pressure pattern and will publish a 72-hour redacted summary.
```

diego: Ack. Ill take the 72h redacted brief. Question: do we include a short "impacting customers" list (service names) or keep it generic? Legal input needed for specifics.

legal_rep: Legal: do not publish raw traces, internal hostnames, PII, session tokens. You can list affected service components (e.g., inference runtime, prefix cache) but avoid customer-specific identifiers in public docs. For enterprise customers under agreement, we can surface more detailed artifacts through secure channels.

abby: Comms + CSM note: agree with legal. Proposed RCA policy entry: "A redacted RCA will be provided to all impacted customers within 72 hours. Customers with contractual rights may request complete artifacts through their account team." I will draft the CSM outreach template.

morgan: OK. Decision path: status page + public line as kim draft, 72h redacted brief by diego, RCA policy text as abby. Timelines please.

kim: Status page & email snippet by tomorrow 15:00 UTC. Ill include a one-line pointer to the 72h summary when its ready.

diego: 72h draft ETA: Friday 16:00 UTC. Ill mark which sections are redacted and flag anything that might need legal review.

abby: RCA policy + CSM template ETA: Friday COB. Ill include guidance on what we can share publicly vs via secure channels and a short script for CSMs to use.

morgan: Remediation owners we also need on the tracker (confirm or correct):
- infra: improved cache-pressure alerts + soft-eviction hook (owner: diego, ETA 10 business days)
- runtime: KV cache defaults & backpressure behavior audit (owner: rachel, ETA 5 business days)
- product: analyze long-prefix query patterns and recommend client-side mitigations (owner: lara, ETA 15 business days)
Add to tracker and link tasks please.

opsbot: Created INC-4780 "Comms: status page, 72h brief, RCA sharing matrix, CSM template" assigned to kim/diego/abby, due 2026-04-16. Link: https://tracker.internal/INC-4780

morgan: Quick callouts: 1) make sure 72h includes clear remediation milestones so customers see progress, 2) CSM template should include who to contact for enterprise artifact requests, 3) tag "recurring" in tracker so ops can prioritize long-term mitigations.

kim: NotedIll add remediation milestones to the status/email copy.

diego: Ill include a short milestones table (high-level) in the 72h doc and mark the deep diagnostics as "enterprise-only" in the notes.

abby: Ill add the contact field and link to the secure request process in the CSM script.

csm_bot: Posted CSM playbook stub: https://internal.docs/csm/playbooks/incident-rca-requests  will update with Abbys template when available.

morgan: Thanks. If any blockers surface, prefix with "blocker:". Will check back tomorrow for status page PR and Friday for 72h and policy PRs. :white_check_mark:
